test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 06 Feb 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: K, L, M, N, S, and P are 6 friends sitting around a circular table facing the centre. P is third to the left of S. K is to the immediate left of S. K and L are sitting opposite each other. M is sitting to the immediate right of S. Who is sitting opposite M?
solution: **K, L, M, N, S, and P** are 6 friends sitting around a circular table facing the centre. 1. P is third to the left of S. 2. K is to the immediate left of S. 3. K and L are sitting opposite each other. 4. M is sitting to the immediate right of S.
